name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
description: Founded in 1870 on Fifth Avenue, the Met holds over two million works spanning five thousand years — from Egyptian temples to European old masters, arms and armour, and photography.
imageCredit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · CC0 — Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale

name: Statens Museum for Kunst
description: Denmark's national gallery, by the Østre Anlæg park, grew out of the Danish kings' art chamber. It is known for the Danish Golden Age, Dutch and Flemish masters, a vast collection of prints and drawings, and its cast collection.
imageCredit: Statens Museum for Kunst · Public domain — Family Portrait

name: Cleveland Museum of Art
description: Free to all since it opened in 1916, the Cleveland Museum of Art is known for its Asian and Egyptian collections, its medieval treasures and its armour court.
imageCredit: Cleveland Museum of Art · CC0 — Dragon and Tiger
